svg.title: Installing only the AI agent files (agent mode) — Saying no to the full framework installs only the AI agent files
svg.text: Installing only the AI agent files (agent mode)
Scenario: Saying no to the full framework installs only the AI agent files

g.text: Given a fresh GitLab project with only a README on its main branch
The empty project after cloning: a README and nothing else. Changing details (dates,
avatars, project name) are hidden so the picture is always the same.
When the developer opens the cloned project in the terminal
A new terminal window: the copy has only the README, and git shows no changes.
And the developer starts the installer and chooses to pick what to
install
The installer asks whether to install everything; the cursor is moved onto "Choose
components" before answering.
And the developer picks the AI agent option from the checklist
A single-choice list: pressing Enter picks the highlighted AI agent option, so you never end
up with nothing selected.
And the installer installs only the AI agent files
The installer confirms what it installed: the AI agent files only.
Then the project folder now holds only the AI agent files
The project folder now: .agent/, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md — and none of the rest of the
framework.
When the developer pushes the AI agent files to main
Agent mode pushes straight to the main branch, with no merge request to review first; GitLab
now lists the AI agent files.

text.tspan: git add -A && git commit -q -m "chore: install the AI agent guardrails" && git push -q

g.text: Then the AI agent files are live on the project's main page
The same project page now shows the AI agent files on main, in the commit "chore: install
the AI agent guardrails".
And the .agent folder can now be opened on GitLab
Inside the .agent folder: the rules, skills and workflows agent mode installed.
